kaikki_vikisozluk.e: نَافٍ • (nāfin) (informal نَافِي (nāfī), feminine نَافِيَة (nāfiya), masculine plural نَافُون (nāfūn), feminine plural نَافِيَات (nāfiyāt))
نَفَى • (nafā) I (non-past يَنْفِي (yanfī), verbal noun نَفْي (nafy))
g: to carry off, to remove, to relegate
to expel, to drive away, to banish

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مَنْفِيّ • (manfiyy) (feminine مَنْفِيَّة (manfiyya), masculine plural مَنْفِيُّون (manfiyyūn), feminine plural مَنْفِيَّات (manfiyyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Derived from the passive participle of the verb نَفَى (nafā).

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: نَافَى • (nāfā) III (non-past يُنَافِي (yunāfī), verbal noun مُنَافَاة (munāfāh))

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From the verb form I نَفَى (nafā, “to expel”).
g: plural of نُفَايَة (nufāya) (singular is almost never used)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِنْتَفَى • (intafā) VIII (non-past يَنْتَفِي (yantafī), verbal noun اِنْتِفَاء (intifāʔ))
g: to fall off or fall away, be negative, exiled, expelled, absent, banished, dropped, non-existent, omitted, denied from
to be contradicted, controverted, disproved, refuted

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: اِسْتَنْفَى • (istanfā) X (non-past يَسْتَنْفِي (yastanfī), verbal noun اِسْتِنْفَاء (istinfāʔ))
g: to reject as worthless, useless, unacceptable

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: مُنْتَفٍ • (muntafin) (informal مُنْتَفِي (muntafī), feminine مُنْتَفِيَة (muntafiya), masculine plural مُنْتَفُون (muntafūn), feminine plural مُنْتَفِيَات (muntafiyāt))
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: Derived from the active participle of اِنْتَفَى (intafā)

kaikki_vikisozluk.e: تَنَافَى • (tanāfā) VI (non-past يَتَنَافَى (yatanāfā), verbal noun تَنَافٍ (tanāfin))
g: to be inconsistent, contradictory, incompatible with
